seo.suffix: Explore ENS name details, resolved address, and owner information.
seo.detail_description: {name} is a {type} domain. Resolved to: {address}. Find owner, records, and related information.

faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.what_is_answer: {name} is a {type} domain name that provides a human-readable identifier for blockchain addresses.
faq.how_to_use: How do I use this name?
faq.how_to_use_answer: You can send cryptocurrency to {name} instead of using the long hexadecimal address. Most wallets and dApps support ENS names.
faq.who_owns_answer: {name} resolves to address {address}. The owner may be different from the resolver address.
faq.how_to_buy: How can I register a similar domain?
faq.how_to_buy_answer: You can register {type} domains through the official registrar. ENS domains are registered at app.ens.domains.

ens.can_expire_answer: Yes, {name} has an expiration date. The current owner must renew it before expiration to retain ownership.
ens.how_to_renew: How do I renew an ENS name?
ens.how_to_renew_answer: To renew {name}, visit app.ens.domains, connect your wallet, and extend the registration period by paying the renewal fee.
ens.how_to_set_records: How do I set records for my ENS name?
ens.how_to_set_records_answer: Visit app.ens.domains, connect the wallet that owns {name}, and you can set various records including addresses, text records, and content hashes.
ens.what_are_records_answer: ENS text records allow you to attach additional information to your name, such as social media handles, website URLs, email, avatar, and description.

entity.who_is_owner: Who is the owner of this domain?
entity.who_is_owner_answer: {name} is registered by {entity}. This is a verified association based on public records.
